A nice setting but a not so great restaurant
Feb 2019 • Friends
Located just beside the Post office designed by Gustav Eiffel (yes the designer of the Tower), this place has a very nice terrace where you can really enjoy a nice evening while taking a beer and enjoying good company but that is all about it. The cuisine itself is average to the most. I ordered a spaghetti carbonara but I had to add salt to make it tasty what is quite surprising for a carbonara. My friend ordered a salad and there was nothing special about it. She eated it all but it was because we were hungry. And my second friend ordered a club sandwich and for once, it was looking like an american made club sandwich without most of the taste. It was OK but you are not going in a restaurant to eat something that is just OK, not to say that a beer was twice the price than most of the restaurants in the surroundings.

Not worth at all
Dec 2018 • Family
Coffee served was just full of ice and just very less coffee .
See the pictures with quality of ice . 
Price was double the coffee at any other place like highland coffee . Taste nothing different than any high street chain local coffee places . I do not recommend them at all . 
On top they charge 5 percent service tax + 10 percent vat also .
Nothing special service given at all .
Had waffles for 100k . Not worth for this price . Waffle taste was ok nothing special . 
I don’t mind giving extra prices to nice cafe provided they have either a special taste or special service or special view. I didn’t get anything here worth paying money .

When I complained about ice filled and less coffee . No one bothered to come back and speak to me .

Horrible service and very average food
Jul 2018 • Family

We ordered two fresh crepes with water and kumquat juice. 
It took 20-25 minutes to come... being French I know how quick it is to do a crepe. 
Taste is average but the reps of my daughter arrived cold, after two bites I send it back asking for a warm crepe. 
Another 5-10mn wait... to see her previous crepe having been put in the microwave! The chocolate sauce on top was dry in some parts. Terrible really.
All that for a price of 318K!!!
No even bother going there, save your money and time

Dinner at this cafe
Jul 2018 • Family
This cafe is in a very lovely area next to the Central Post Office and Notre Dame. The food was good, service was great and reasonably priced for the area. We had a typical Saigon storm and the manger went out of his way to try and get us a taxi home. He rang multiple times for a taxi and stood outside on the street with his umbrella trying to hail a taxi and after being unsuccessful he apologised many times. The only down side was a strong fishy smell in the cafe that put me off my food a bit
